records.name: React UMenu
records.purpose: Flat inline or imperative popup command and navigation list.
records.surface: UMenu forwards UMenuHandle with toggle(event), show(event), hide(event?). UMenuProps requires model: UMenuItem[]; optional popup=false, popupAlignment (accepted but unread), id, ariaLabel, ariaLabelledBy, className, style, baseZIndex, appendTo, closeOnEscape=true, onShow and onHide. UMenuItem has optional label, ReactNode icon, command({originalEvent,item}), disabled, separator, visible, url and recursive items; this renderer remains flat and does not consume items. The list has role menu, tabIndex=0 and aria-activedescendant, clamps ArrowUp/Down, supports Home/End and Enter/Space invocation, Tab dismissal and Alt+ArrowUp focus return. Popup uses Portal, useOverlayListener, useGlobalEscapeKey, useDisplayOrder/ESCAPE_PRIORITIES, useZIndex and useMotion; useUpdateEffect and useUnmountEffect manage lifecycle. onShow runs in show; onHide runs in onAfterLeave, after clearing z-index and listeners. containerVisible retains mounting through leave; portalReady resets for reopening. Inline toggle is guarded, but show/hide are not popup-guarded. Local popup CSS starts at top/left -9999px; no target positioning measurement is implemented. MENU_METADATA references this React source and models shown/hidden callbacks; metadata is not runtime integration. menuStyleModule is the owned source-only StyleModule adapter (css and classes), not a public package export. No separate base class, props factory, directive, context/provider or exported hook exists under this family root. records.purpose: Floating action toggle with linear or circular secondary actions.
records.surface: USpeedDial forwards USpeedDialHandle with show()/hide(). USpeedDialProps: model defaults [], icon, direction=up, type=linear, radius=0, transitionDelay=30ms, mask=false, disabled=false, closeOnEscape=true, ariaLabel, onVisibleChange(boolean), onClick(MouseEvent), onShow, onHide, className. Public USpeedDialDirection allows up/down/left/right/up-left/up-right/down-left/down-right; USpeedDialType allows linear/circle/semi-circle/quarter-circle. The native toggle button (not UButton) has aria-expanded/haspopup/label and disabled; imperative show is not disabled-guarded. State updater callbacks emit visibility and show/hide once per transition. Document Escape hides while open; optional mask click hides.
